assets.scope: Native player body family (paper-doll), not a class or NPC; identity key descriptor.subrace x descriptor.sex -> moddable_tile per overload/mod/class/CheckerPlayerTokens.lua. Covers birth subrace Dwarf at sex=Male (moddable_tile "dwarf_#sex#"; native default cosmetic ornament for this sex is a beard). Runtime id player-dwarf-male, exported to data/gfx/tokens/player-dwarf-male.png.

references.note: Approved style anchor: reuse its steep overhead three-quarter camera, matte painted miniature finish, thin charcoal-brown disc and bronze-grey bevel at exactly that lightness. Do not copy its crouching combat pose, bald head, daggers, leather vest or sash; this token is a calm standing figure in plain traveller's clothes with no weapon.

Native unequipped paper-doll base body (skin-tone option 1 of several cosmetic choices; any option is equally native). Establishes body proportions and base skin/fur/bone value only: a short, stocky, wide-shouldered man; native cosmetic options add a beard by default (moddable_tile_ornament2), which this token keeps as an identity trait, not equipment. Ignore its flat front-facing T-pose, flat top light and total nudity; the token uses the style reference's camera, disc and pose instead, and the figure must be dressed per the brief.

prompt_fields.subject: One adult dwarf man, short, stocky and wide-shouldered, standing in a calm neutral pose, weight even on both feet, arms relaxed at his sides with open hands. A visible short, full beard on the jaw and chin (a natural feature, not equipment). Wears a simple long-sleeved tunic belted at the waist over plain trousers and sturdy low boots.
prompt_fields.contrast: Must read apart from human/elf and, most of all, from halfling_male at 48px in grayscale: (1) silhouette — noticeably shorter and much broader through the shoulders and torso than any other family, with a visible beard adding mass to the lower face/jaw silhouette; (2) value — a compact, dense body mass reads as one broad dark-mid value block rather than the halfling's smaller, more rounded block. The halfling in this same package must NOT share this beard or this shoulder width; it must read as a distinctly smaller, slighter, big-headed body, not a smaller copy of this dwarf.
prompt_fields.composition: One entire figure on one disc, steep overhead three-quarter view, facing down-left or down-right. Head, hands and feet stay well inside the disc with a clear margin; the outer sixth of the disc radius stays bare base plate. Keep the head out of the upper-right rank corner and the upper-left interaction corner. No second figure, no mount, no companion, no ground clutter.
prompt_fields.palette: Ruddy, weathered mid-tone skin, brown, auburn or grey beard and hair, a plain earth-toned tunic (rust, umber or slate), darker trousers and heavy boots. No bright saturated dye, no metallic sheen, no jewellery.
